comment: Old Smokestack as a puppet: one sheet of parts made with an image AI (see PROMPT.txt). `npm run art -- smokestack` cuts it into public/art/smokestack/ and finds the face, wheels, smokestack, ground and nose by itself (check art/smokestack/preview.png). Any anchor can be forced here in sheet pixels. `flip` mirrors parts: we see the train's left side, so the near hand is a LEFT hand seen from the palm: all three gloves need the thumb on the RIGHT (here the fist and the pointing one came out with it on the left).
